scenario:
A global academic organization is developing a comprehensive database management system to track and manage international academic exchange programs. This system will support various scholarship and exchange programs, such as the Fulbright U.S. Scholar Program, involving scholars from different home institutions who are hosted at universities worldwide. The system must manage detailed information about scholars, including their home and host institutions, academic disciplines, program countries, and the duration of their academic years.

The organization requires the ability to analyze trends in academic disciplines and geographic distribution of scholars. Additionally, the system needs to provide insights into the collaboration patterns between home and host institutions. This platform should offer advanced search capabilities to find scholars based on specific criteria, including home institution, host institution, discipline, and program year. Furthermore, the system should support the management of program logistics, such as visa information and financial aid distribution.

An essential feature of the system will be the ability to generate reports and statistics for stakeholders, such as government agencies, educational institutions, and funding bodies, to evaluate the impact and effectiveness of these exchange programs. The platform should also facilitate communication and networking among scholars, fostering a global academic community.
